title: 4403 - Software Development Engineer-II (Finance - AI Engineering)
description:
**About The Role**
 Every finance team runs on spreadsheets, tribal knowledge, and manual reconciliation between systems that were never meant to talk to each other. We think that's about to change — and we want the engineer who builds that change here first.
   

  

 This isn't a "finance systems" role. It's not reporting, it's not maintaining dashboards, and it's not writing SQL for someone else's requirements doc. This is a build role for someone who wants to take a real, high\-stakes function — the one that runs the company's numbers, forecasts, and capital decisions — and rebuild it from the ground up as a set of intelligent, autonomous systems.
   

  

 You'll have direct access to the Head of Strategic Finance, the CFO's office, and full latitude to decide
 *how* 
 things get built. If you've ever looked at a finance team drowning in manual work and thought "this should just be automated," this is the job where you get to prove it — with real production systems, real business impact, and a leadership team that will move out of your way.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
* Sit inside the finance function, understand how it actually works — not the theory, the real mess of systems, spreadsheets, close cycles, and judgment calls — and figure out what should never require a human again
* Design and build autonomous agents that pull data from multiple systems, reason over it, and produce decision\-ready output — not static reports, but systems that plan, check their own work, and flag what actually needs a human
* Own the full stack: data pipelines, integrations across ERP/CRM/finance systems, orchestration logic, and the AI layer that sits on top of all of it
* Make sharp build\-vs\-buy calls — know when to write code, when to use an existing tool, and when to reach for an LLM instead of a rules engine
* Ship fast, in production, with real users depending on your systems for actual financial decisions — not prototypes that live in a demo forever
* Be the person who defines what "AI\-native finance" even means at Innovaccer, because right now, nobody has done it yet


**What You Need**
* You've built AI agents before. Not called an API and wrapped a chat UI around it — actually designed multi\-step, tool\-using, autonomous or semi\-autonomous systems that do real work with minimal human babysitting
* You're a strong engineer, full stop. Solid computer science fundamentals, clean system design instincts, and the ability to take ambiguous problems and turn them into working software without a spec handed to you
* You're comfortable with the modern AI toolchain — LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, coding assistants (Claude, Codex, and similar), prompt and context engineering, evaluation and guardrails. You know the difference between a cool demo and something that's reliable enough to run a business process
* You're genuinely curious about how a business runs. You don't need a finance background — you need the instinct to walk into an unfamiliar domain, ask sharp questions, and quickly figure out the actual workflow before you write a line of code
* You default to automation. When you see a repetitive process, your first thought is "why is a human doing this," not "let me build a dashboard so a human can do it faster."
* You can work with ambiguity and incomplete requirements. This function is being invented in real time — you'll often be defining the problem, not just solving it


**Here's What We Offer**
* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most
* Care Program: Whether it's a celebration or a time of need, we've got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we're here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most


 Innovaccer is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.
   

  

**Disclaimer:** 
 Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.
   

  

**About Innovaccer**
 Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.
   

  

 Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.
   

  

 Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.
   

  

 The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi\-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare\-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com and check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

title: Manager-FDI-FINANCE TECH
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
 As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno\-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data\-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP\&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As\-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross\-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in\-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.


**What We Look For**
* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Position Title: FSCM \- Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an SAP FSCM Manager, you will lead the financial supply chain management initiatives within the organization, driving improvements in cash flow, credit management, and collections processes. This role offers the chance to oversee the implementation and optimization of SAP FSCM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enhancing overall financial performance.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Leadership: Manage the FSCM team, providing guidance and support to ensure effective execution of financial supply chain strategies.
* Implementation: Oversee the configuration and deployment of SAP FSCM solutions to meet organizational needs.
* Process Improvement: Identify and implement best practices to optimize credit management, collections, and dispute resolution processes.
* Data Analysis: Analyze financial data to provide insights and drive strategic decision\-making.
* Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams to align financial processes with overall business objectives.
* User Training: Develop and deliver training programs for end\-users on FSCM functionalities.
* Troubleshooting: Address and resolve issues related to the FSCM module, ensuring system reliability.
* Reporting: Generate and present reports on financial performance and process efficiency to senior management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Should be aware S4HANA credit management functionalities.
* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience in SAP FSCM Credit Management, Collection Management and Dispute Management, cash application\-High Rad Integration.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Develop and deliver training programs for end\-users on FSCM functionalities.


**What We Look For**
* Resource must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance / Mcom.
* Should have minimum 7\-11 years of experience on SAP S4 Hana Credit / Collection / Dispute Management.
* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience in SAP FSCM Credit Management, Collection Management and Dispute Management, cash application\-High Rad Integration.
* Must have knowledge on 3rd party interface integration for credit management.
* Should have knowledge on credit score calculation.
* Should be aware S4HANA credit management functionalities.
* Should have hands on experience to prepare functional specifications.
* Should have knowledge in SAP FI Account Receivables.
* Should be able to independently handle complex technical PO requirements.
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Costing manager
description:
**Job Description: Costing Manager / Senior Costing Professional**
**Job Title**
 Costing Manager / Senior Costing Professional
   

  

**Department**
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**Location**
 Noida
   

  

****Experience****
 3 – 5 Years
   

  

**Qualification**
 ICWA / CMA preferred
   

  

**Industry**
 Chemical / Manufacturing / EPS Resin
   

  

**Maximum CTC**
 ₹15 LPA
   

  

****Position Overview****
 EPACK Petrochem Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced Costing Professional to lead product costing, cost control, and margin analysis for its EPS resin manufacturing operations. The role will partner closely with Production, Procurement, and Finance to drive cost efficiency, accurate product costing, and strong financial discipline across the plant.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard costing systems for EPS resin products, including raw material, conversion, and overhead costs.
* Prepare product\-wise and batch\-wise cost sheets; track and analyze cost variances (material, labour, overhead) against standards/budgets.
* Conduct monthly cost analysis, margin analysis, and profitability reporting by product/SKU for management review.
* Monitor raw material (styrene monomer and related inputs) price movements and their impact on product costing and margins.
* Support annual budgeting, standard cost revisions, and periodic cost audits in coordination with Finance.
* Drive cost reduction and cost optimization initiatives across procurement, production, and inventory management.
* Ensure accurate valuation of inventory (raw material, WIP, finished goods) as per applicable accounting standards.
* Coordinate with plant/production teams to validate process yields, wastage norms, and conversion cost drivers.
* Support statutory audit, internal audit, and cost audit (CMA) requirements with timely and accurate cost data/documentation.
* Prepare MIS reports and cost dashboards for senior management, highlighting key cost trends and improvement opportunities.


****Candidate Requirements****
**Education**
 ICWA / CMA (preferred); B.Com / M.Com with relevant costing exposure also considered
   

  

****Experience****
 3–5 years in costing/cost accounting, preferably in a chemical, polymer, or manufacturing industry
   

  

****Core Skills****
 Standard costing, variance analysis, cost sheets, inventory valuation, MIS reporting
   

  

**Systems**
 Proficiency in ERP (SAP/Oracle preferred) and advanced MS Excel
   

  

**Industry Exposure**
 Chemical / Manufacturing / EPS Resin industry background preferred
   

  

****Preferred Candidate Profile****
* Prior experience in a chemical, polymer, plastics, or petrochemical manufacturing environment is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to standard costing, process costing, and variance analysis in a manufacturing setup.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems (SAP/Oracle or similar) for costing and inventory modules.
* Strong analytical, Excel, and MIS reporting skills.
* High attention to detail with the ability to work cross\-functionally with Plant, Procurement, and Finance teams.


****Compensation****
**Maximum CTC:** 
 ₹15 LPA (commensurate with experience and qualification)
   

  

 Skills: product costing,management,manufacturing,resin

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 




 Hookaba is a bold, wearable LED lifestyle brand that blends fashion and technology to help people express themselves with light. From LED backpacks to glow\-up accessories, we design standout products for those who aren’t afraid to be seen. We're a fast\-growing startup redefining self\-expression through innovation and style.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time on\-site role for an Accountant, located in Noida. The Accountant will be responsible for managing financial transactions, preparing financial reports, reconciling accounts, and ensuring compliance with legal requirements. Daily tasks include Tally invoicing, maintaining records of assets, liabilities, profit and loss, tax liability, and other financial activities. The Accountant will also assist in budgeting and forecasting, and provide support for audits and financial planning.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Expertise in accounting principles, financial reporting, and budget preparation
* Experience handling accounting of Market places like (Amazon, Flipkart)
* Experience in handling Imports \& Exports
* Proficiency in accounts payable, accounts receivable, and ledger management
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to ensure compliance with regulations
* Experience with accounting software and tools
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* Prior experience in a similar accounting role preferred








**Please do not apply here if you are looking for fancy corporate office, organized way of working** 




  





**But please apply** 



* If you are looking to make an impact
* If you are willing to work directly with Founder
* If you are willing to invest your time and energy today for hopeful exponential growth tomorrow
